## Acceptance criteria

1. RED-first: a test drives two concurrent `RuntimeLocal` invocations against the same handler/topic and demonstrates cross-talk today (invocation A observes/accepts invocation B's terminal event, or vice versa).
2. GREEN: after the fix, each invocation only ever accepts its own correlation-scoped terminal event and only ever processes handler input scoped to its own correlation ID, proven by the same concurrent-invocation test now passing.
3. Both call sites (`runtime_local.py:594` terminal group, `:1211`/`:1226` handler group) are covered — a fix that scopes only one path is incomplete.
